actions_add_asset_description: Scan or type the printed tag. Can be left blank and bound later.
actions_add_item_description: Leave off for something that gets used up — that is what makes an item a consumable.
actions_adjust_credits_positive_add_nega: Positive to add, negative to deduct
actions_adjust_credits_why_adjustment_be: Why is this adjustment being made?
actions_adjust_stock_enter_what_counted_: Enter what you counted. The difference is recorded as its own entry, so the discrepancy stays on the record rather than the total being quietly overwritten.
actions_adjust_stock_matches_record_subm: Matches the record. Submitting will change nothing.
actions_adjust_stock_system_currently_sh: The system currently shows {#strong}{onHand}{/strong} on hand.
actions_anything_else_would_help_us: Anything else that would help us review this
actions_band_cancel_event_cancel_event_l: Cancel this event? The listing stays up marked as cancelled, and this cannot be undone.
actions_band_publish_event_publish_event: Publish this event? It becomes visible on your profile and the public calendar.
actions_band_unpublish_event_take_event_: Take this event back to a draft? It stops showing publicly until you publish it again.
actions_bind_tag_binding_new_one_keeps_e: Binding a new one keeps every loan and repair already recorded against it.
actions_bind_tag_scan_type_tag_printed_s: Scan or type the tag printed on the sticker.
actions_bulk_add_members_add_all_active_: Add all active members to this audience?
actions_cancel_event_cancel_event_cannot: Cancel this event? This cannot be undone.
actions_cancel_reservation_sure_want_can: Are you sure you want to cancel this reservation?
actions_cancel_series_cancel_recurring_s: Cancel this recurring series? Your next session is cancelled and later ones are removed. Any already paid for are cancelled and refunded instead.
actions_cash_received_record_cash_was_re: Record that cash was received for this reservation?
actions_confirm_waitlisted_have_until_co: You have until {formatDate} to confirm before the slot is offered to someone else.
actions_confirm_waitlisted_slot_has_open: A slot has opened up for this time. Would you like to confirm this reservation?
actions_create_audience_description: Show on public subscribe page and member account
actions_create_loan_could_not_load_equip: Could not load the equipment list: {errorMessage}
actions_delete_audience_delete_audience_: Delete this audience? All subscribers will be removed.
actions_delete_event_if_show_was_real_is: If the show was real and isn't happening, {#strong}cancel{/strong} it instead: that keeps it on the calendar marked cancelled so anyone who had the date finds out.
actions_delete_event_lineup_credit_show_: {lineupCount} lineup credit{value} — the show disappears from those bands' profiles
actions_delete_event_removes_event_outri: This removes the event outright. Use it for something that shouldn't exist — a test row, a duplicate, a spam listing.
actions_delete_event_title: Events with tickets can't be deleted — cancel it instead, which voids the tickets and tells the people holding them.
actions_invite_by_email_invite_someone_w: Invite someone who doesn't have a CorvMC account. They'll get a signup link and be auto-added to this band.
actions_mark_returned_checkbox_label: Keep it off the shelf until fixed
actions_message_member_goes_as_message_r: This goes to {recipientName} as a message request. They'll see it in their Messages and can accept or decline — you'll be able to write again once they accept.
actions_message_member_placeholder: Say who you are and what you're after
actions_no_show_reservation_mark_reserva: Mark this reservation as a no-show?
actions_publish_event_fix_these_first_if: Fix these first if you can. To publish anyway, say why; it is recorded.
actions_publish_event_publish_event_make: Publish this event to make it visible to the public?
actions_receive_stock_checkbox_label: The collective converted this gift to cash
actions_receive_stock_gift_as_whole_leav: The gift as a whole. Leave blank to let the per-unit values above stand for it.
actions_receive_stock_guess_fine_nothing: A guess is fine. Nothing counts an opening balance as spending.
actions_receive_stock_paid_by_leave_blan: Paid by (leave blank if the collective paid)
actions_receive_stock_required_gifts_kin: Required for the gifts-in-kind disclosure — e.g. comparable sales, appraisal.
actions_record_form8282_description: e.g. “Filed 2026-09-02, copy posted to the donor” or “No 8283 was ever signed, so no filing due”.
actions_record_form8282_record_either_wa: Record either that it was filed, or that no filing was needed and why. Check with whoever prepares the return if you are unsure — this note is the only record.
actions_record_form8282_unit_was_donated: This unit was donated and disposed of within three years, so the IRS may require Form 8282 — filed within 125 days of the disposal, with a copy to the donor
actions_record_form8283_description: Gifts over $5,000 need a qualified appraisal. Note where it is filed.
actions_record_form8283_donor_claiming_d: A donor claiming a deduction over $5,000 asks the collective to sign their Form 8283. Record that here once it is signed.
actions_record_form8283_what_makes_gift_: This is what makes the gift reportable if it is later sold or disposed of within three years — leave it unrecorded and no Form 8282 warning will ever be raised for it.
actions_refund_reservation_checkbox_labe: Also cancel this reservation (releases the slot to the waitlist and notifies the member)
actions_refund_reservation_payment_refun: The payment is refunded and the booking is not cancelled, for a session that went ahead.
actions_remove_category_delete_category_: Delete "{name}"? Category must have no equipment.
actions_remove_event_poster_remove_poste: Remove the poster from this event?
actions_report_building_problem_whatever: Whatever you noticed is enough. For a broken amp or mic, report it from the equipment's own page instead.
actions_report_building_problem_which_ro: Which room or area — “downstairs bathroom”, “Room B”, “the back door”.
actions_report_content_let_staff_know_wh: Let staff know what's wrong with this content. Reports are private and reviewed by the CMC team.
actions_report_damage_description: Whatever you noticed is enough — staff will follow up.
actions_report_damage_takes_item_out_ser: This takes the item out of service until staff have looked at it.
actions_report_event_e_g_inappropriate_c: e.g. Inappropriate content, misleading info, spam
actions_report_event_let_staff_know_what: Let staff know what's wrong with this listing. Reports are private and reviewed by the CMC team.
actions_send_contact_sheet_sends_private: Sends a private link where the act fills in its own details. Preferred over typing them in on their behalf — what we hold is then what they chose to give us.
actions_transfer_ownership_transfer_owne: Transfer ownership to {name}? The current owner will be demoted to admin.
actions_unpublish_event_description: Sent to whoever posted this and kept on the listing. Required for a community listing, which the poster can appeal. Leave blank for CMC events, which notify nobody.
actions_unpublish_event_revert_event_dra: Revert this event to draft? It will no longer be visible to the public.
actions_unschedule_campaign_cancel_sched: Cancel the scheduled send and return this campaign to draft?
